tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask any question and get a sourced answer. It draws on the customer's own site pages, the governing law and official sources, each with a link to the source. customer is OPTIONAL; omit it for general questions.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List the customer corpora this connector serves, with page counts and freshness. Use ask() for actual queries.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a bounded snippet + metadata for a result id returned by ask(). Full text at the public source URL.

tools.name: pauhu_code
tools.description: Synthesize a program from an intent. Returns clean, sourced code, or says when it can't.

tools.name: pauhu_ops
tools.description: List the operations a program can be built from; describe a function in terms of them in pauhu_code.

tools.name: pauhu_translate
tools.description: Translate text between languages, with exact sourced terms.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Returns the text in an image: printed pages, receipts, forms, screenshots or handwriting.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Turns text into spoken audio (WAV, base64).

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Returns the words spoken in an audio recording.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches the public web and returns matching pages as title, URL and snippet, each attributed to its own URL. Free.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Reads one public web page and returns its text. Pages whose site does not allow automated reading are refused.

tools.name: contribute
tools.description: Offer a question with a checkable answer, a missing source, a wrong-answer report or an unanswered tool request. Accepted contributions earn usage credit on your Pauhu balance. Requires your Pauhu key.

tools.name: pauhu_search
tools.description: Search Pauhu's sourced knowledge. Returns a sourced answer, its sources (document id and URL) and per-match snippets; every answer traces to a source.

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description: Shows what an output costs before you call it, as currently served, and how to pay for it. Free.

tools.name: balance_top_up
tools.description: Reads what is left on your prepaid balance (connect with your balance key), or gives the payment page that tops it up. Free.

tools.name: pauhu_till
tools.description: Session tally of the tool calls made through this server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
